title: Mochizuki Honami — Profile Story

rows.Line: Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Okay, I believe I'm next.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Hello, everyone.
I'm Honami Mochizuki, the drummer for Leo/need.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Thank you very much for coming to see our show today.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
So, since I'm giving a self-intro...
I think I'll talk about myself.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Some of you may already know this, but we're a band made up of childhood friends...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: We've been very close ever since we were little, but we've also gone through our share of rough patches. Including not talking to each other for a while...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
However, I couldn't be happier now...
Not only are we back in a band together, we were able to go pro.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: To tell the truth, we had to go through quite a lot and make a number of tough decisions in order to make it this far...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I caused others around me a lot of trouble in the past because of my indecisiveness. Yes, I know this is a personal matter...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But being in a band has taught me to stand up for myself.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
And how to really be there for others.
How to have the courage to make decisions when it really matters.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm sure we'll be faced with some scary situations in the future. Especially now that we've gone pro.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But even so...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I plan on staying strong.
I won't be afraid of making tough decisions.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, uh... I didn't mean to get so worked up.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But I meant every word.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
So, everyone...
We're going to do our best, so we'll be looking forward to your continued support.
